ticker_news.title: 1 Vanguard ETF to Invest In That Can Turn $500 Monthly Into $800,000
ticker_news.description: The Vanguard Growth ETF (VUG) has demonstrated strong historical performance, averaging around 12% annual returns since 2004. By investing $500 monthly, investors could potentially grow their investment to approximately $800,000 over two decades, particularly due to its focus on large-cap tech growth stocks.
ticker_news.author: Stefon Walters

ticker_news.title: Why Is China Against Qualcomm's Autotalks Acquisition?
ticker_news.description: Qualcomm's stock dropped after China launched an antitrust investigation into its acquisition of Autotalks, signaling increased regulatory scrutiny on U.S. tech firms ahead of a potential summit between Presidents Trump and Xi Jinping.
ticker_news.author: Anusuya Lahiri
